messages:
lucy: quick q from spike: region-specific policy blobs can disagree on tie-break. do we force a global tiebreak or allow region-local differences?
omar: show example pls.
lucy: eu blob prefers eu-gpu-1 for latency, us blob prefers us-gpu-2 for cost. a cross-region flow might hit inconsistent ordering.
ben: strong preference for deterministic global tie-break using stable key (tenant+model+req_hash). makes debugging and audits easier.
natalie: need escape hards: some rules are data-residency hard-constraints and must win before any tie-break. DSL must express hard vs soft.
lucy: proposal: evaluate hard-constraints first; then comparator uses normalized weight, dynamic penalties, then stable key. add `weight_norm_version` to blob header.
omar: tenants love extreme weights; clamp and renormalize per blob. include version so sim can compare.
ben: add `blob_id` and `parent_blob_id` for tracing and telemetry diffing.
atalie: rollout thought: do per-region staged canaries to avoid global mismatches; global policies go percentage-based.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: added harmony check to warn when deterministic order differs across target regions.
ben: telemetry: emit small diff when runtime selection != preflight: {expected_blob_id, actual_blob_id, path, latency_pred_ms}.
omar: minimize RPC safe-eval usage: only call for ambiguous comparator outcomes; instrument to keep RPC <15ms p95.
lucy: owners: i'll draft proto and harmony check. omar: weight normalization + tests. ben: blob tracing + telemetry. natalie: rollout playbook and compat flags. I'll open PR tomorrow with sim snapshot. :rocket:
